summary: CloudIVR web Bulk IVR >500 split choices (auto / ask / part 'First 500 now, keep the rest' / first 'Only the first 500'). Backend: new pytest suite of 16 tests, all passing (first-mode trim in list order, trimmedFrom, repeat allowed only for first, part-mode Part1 500 + Part2 waiting, payPerPart/autoNext, dry-run part1 complete -> part2 series_ready, start of the ready part, drop of waiting/ready parts with cascade to later parts, clear error when cancelling a finished/cancelled part, cancelling part 1 cascades, start of a waiting part rejected, <=500 normal, auto/ask 402 with 'all N parts', >5000 rejected, low-wallet 402 messages for first/part mention only the first 500 / part 1). Frontend (Playwright, desktop + mobile): split card with 4 radios, summary switches to 'only the first 500 are called', no card at 500; UI create in first mode -> detail series note 'Only the first 500 of your 700 numbers…' + list pill 'first 500 of 700'; part mode -> pills 'Part 1 of 2 · pay per part' / 'Part 2 of 2 · pay per part' + 'waits for part 1'; after part 1 finished -> 'ready to start' + row button 'Start & pay part 2' (works, row goes to running); detail of part 2 shows 'Start & pay part 2' + 'Drop this part'; drop asks for confirmation ('Keep them' keeps it, 'Drop' cancels it + toast 'Remaining parts dropped'); low-wallet error text shows inline in the form for first/part/auto. Everything requested works. Only minor UX issues were found.

minor.issue: The preview dry-run path changes series_ready to created and runs the simulation without the per-part wallet check that startSeriesPart does. This only affects preview, but the 'Start & pay part N' low-wallet 402 cannot be tested in preview. The real path (startSeriesPart) was only reviewed in code, not run.

ui_bugs.issue: The count is the number of pasted lines, not unique numbers. 700 lines with only 350 unique numbers show the split card ('700 numbers → 2 parts'). The server removes duplicates and creates one normal 350-number campaign (skipped=0), so the card is misleading for lists with duplicates.

issues: The selected radio card is hard to tell apart from the others: only a slightly lighter accent border, and the bg-accent/10 tint is almost invisible on the dark theme, mostly on mobile. Add a check icon or a stronger tint/border.
After a part is dropped (status cancelled), campaign-series-note still says 'Pay per part: each next part waits for you to start it…'. It should say the part was dropped.
'Check 1240 numbers before calling' has no thousands separator, while the split card shows '1,240' (small inconsistency).

action_items: (Low) In SplitNote/LeadCount, count unique normalized numbers so lists with duplicates don't show the split card by mistake.
(Low) Make the selected split option easier to see.
(Low) Change SeriesNote text when the part's status is cancelled (dropped).
critical_code_review_comments: bulk-call-service createSeries 'first' builds its low-balance message from w.usdBal only. The other branches fall back to getBalance. Fine today, because smartWalletCheck always returns usdBal.
calls.js dry-run start of a series_ready part skips the payPerPart wallet check (preview only). Consider calling the same wallet estimate there so preview behaves like live.

Controls in CampaignDetail.js call useBalance(0) for series_ready, so 'Start & pay part N' is never disabled for a low wallet before the click. The server returns 402 instead. Consider useBalance(part estimate) for payPerPart.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test campaigns (TEST_split_*, TEST_ui_*) were deleted by id/splitId (only the 2 seeded 'Split test' campaigns remain). The uxtest wallet was lowered to $100/$10 for the low-wallet tests and restored to usdIn 1000 / usdOut 0 (checked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cloudivr_split_first_part.py -p no:xdist. It uses pymongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env) to fast-forward dry-run parts (marks part 1 leads completed) and to change the wallet (uxtest chatId 5000000000000077), then restores it. The sim step is 1.5 s per lead, so 500 leads take about 12 minutes unless fast-forwarded. Login button: get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'); the audio select is a native select (campaign-audio-select, value aud-split-test). Bot not retested, as instructed.
